summary: The Sync - Skia Upstream workflow failed because its staged create-pull-request output targeted a release branch that was not allowed as a base-branch override.

bugSignals.errorMessage: create_pull_request: Base branch override is not allowed. Configure safe-outputs.create-pull-request.allowed-base-branches to allow per-run base overrides.

stepsToReproduce: Run the Sync - Skia Upstream workflow for a release-line target.
Let the workflow resolve the release branch as the pull request base.
Observe that the staged create-pull-request safe output is rejected because that base branch is not allowlisted.
reproEvidence.environmentDetails: GitHub Actions Sync - Skia Upstream workflow run 37048491850 on the mono/SkiaSharp main branch.

repoLinks.description: Previously triaged occurrence of the same create_pull_request base-branch override failure.
Subsequent open occurrence showing the failure still recurs for a release branch.
Draft fix explicitly linked by the issue, with regression coverage for the workflow source and compiled safe-output configuration.

fixStatus.reason: Draft PR #5259 describes the required allowlist change and regression coverage, but it remains open and therefore has not fixed the workflow on its active branch.

analysis.summary: The workflow deliberately resolves either a manually supplied base branch or a release branch and passes it through to its staged pull-request completion signal. The safe-output declaration enables staged create-pull-request but does not configure allowed base branches, so the safe-output policy rejects that valid resolved target before the sync can be recorded.
analysis.rationale: This is a deterministic CI workflow configuration defect, not an application API issue. The workflow source accepts and emits the resolved branch while the compiled safe-output configuration lacks an allowed-base-branches setting; the exact failure has recurred and a linked draft PR supplies the narrowly scoped remedy.

keySignals.text: create_pull_request: Base branch override is not allowed. Configure safe-outputs.create-pull-request.allowed-base-branches to allow per-run base overrides.
keySignals.interpretation: The safe-output policy, rather than the Skia merge logic, blocks completion.

keySignals.text: Allow the explicitly selected branch for manual runs, and main or release/* for normal runs.
keySignals.interpretation: A focused, reviewed fix path already exists.

codeInvestigation.finding: The workflow exposes a target_branch manual override and declares staged create-pull-request without an allowed-base-branches configuration.
The detector validates and resolves a supplied base branch, or derives a release branch, then emits base_branch for the later workflow stages.
The generated workflow's GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS_CONFIG contains staged create_pull_request settings but no allowed-base-branches entry, matching the reported rejection.

workarounds: Until the workflow configuration is merged, avoid using the staged create-pull-request completion path for a release-branch sync and complete the resulting pull request through the established manual release workflow.
For an already prepared sync, use the linked draft PR #5259 as the tracked fix rather than repeatedly rerunning the unchanged workflow.

resolution.hypothesis: The workflow's dynamic base-branch resolution was added without the matching safe-output allowlist required for per-run pull-request base overrides.

proposals.title: Merge the safe-output base-branch allowlist
proposals.description: Review and merge PR #5259 so the workflow permits the manually selected base branch and its normal main or release branch targets, then regenerate and verify the compiled workflow configuration.

resolution.recommendedReason: It directly addresses the reported policy rejection and is already implemented in the linked draft PR with stated regression coverage.

actionability.reason: The root cause and narrow configuration change are confirmed, and draft PR #5259 already contains the proposed fix and regression coverage.

actions.description: Apply the workflow bug, build area, and reliability labels.
Link the subsequent recurrence for consolidated workflow-failure tracking.
